answer_1.quote: Complex VQA, as a high-level form of VQA, requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to understand the situational relationships within the video content, thereby presenting textual answers to the user's complex questions.

answer_2.quote: On average, VQAGuider leads to performance improvements of 33.7%, 16.6%, ... confirming the effectiveness of VQAGuider in boosting MLLMs' complex VQA capabilities.

answer_3.quote: The readability is assessed using GPT-4o on a 1-5 scale (1 being the worst and 5 being the best). For path planning, GPT-4o is also used to score the reasonableness of the designed path on a 1-5 scale.
